author: The Infographics Show
description:
You’re not losing your job tomorrow, but AI is already learning how to replace you.
And the companies building it aren’t being honest about what comes next.

In this episode, we break down the real story behind OpenAI and the push toward Artificial General Intelligence (AGI).
What’s being sold as a tool to empower you may actually be the system that makes your skills irrelevant. From the collapse of the traditional resume to a future where machines outperform humans at nearly every job, this isn’t just innovation, it’s disruption on a massive scale.

We uncover the hidden costs behind the AI race. Billions in losses, impossible energy demands, and a global infrastructure gamble that may never pay off.
As companies chase superintelligence, power is concentrating into the hands of a few, creating a new elite class controlling access to intelligence itself.

And if human labor disappears, what happens to the economy? To democracy? To you?

This isn’t science fiction. It’s already happeni
title: The OpenAI Lie. Their AGI Masterplan Will BREAK Society.
